snapshot: uncommitted working tree; source hashes below identify the compiled package
scope: Finite native interfaces across all 40 installed toolkit families. No full upstream API parity claim.

status_definitions.partial: A finite native contract exists. Remaining family gaps are listed.
status_definitions.host_only: Host facility; unavailable as generated host code.
status_definitions.unavailable: No generated interface. Remaining work needs a new contract.
status_definitions.implemented: The stated finite interface exists in code. This status alone does not prove rendered behavior.

verification.expected: Both production and instrumentation Kotlin sources compile.

families.implemented_contract: column, nonwrapping row, flowRow, box overlay, adaptive grid, scroll; parent weight/alignment
families.remaining_gap: No arbitrary layout callbacks, custom measurement, or ConstraintLayout API.

families.implemented_contract: Bounded dimensions, constraints, aspect ratio, finite insets and arrangement
families.remaining_gap: No breakpoint expressions, intrinsic measurement, or arbitrary modifier chain.

families.implemented_contract: lazyList, stable keys, bounded viewport, selected/scroll target key
families.remaining_gap: No item-visibility callbacks, prefetch policy, or unbounded collections.

families.implemented_contract: lazyGrid, responsive column count, rowTemplate, groupBy, validated spanField
families.remaining_gap: No staggered grid or arbitrary span callback.

families.implemented_contract: Native HorizontalPager, bounded page index event, previous/next actions, current-page action authority
families.remaining_gap: No infinite pager, fractional scroll callback, or route stack.

families.implemented_contract: groupBy, lazyList stickyHeaders, lazyGrid full-width group headers, swipeAction references visible rowActions
families.remaining_gap: No free drag reorder or drag/drop. Explicit row actions can reorder script state with stable keys.

families.family: Buttons, icon buttons, and floating actions
families.implemented_contract: Native filled/outlined/text/tonal/elevated buttons, FAB and extended FAB, bounded glyphs
families.remaining_gap: No loading-button state machine or Material icon pack. Disabled FAB uses a disabled tonal button.

families.implemented_contract: actionChip assist/suggestion variants; boolean chip filter/input variants; optional remove action
families.remaining_gap: No avatar or arbitrary leading/trailing slots. Input-chip removal remains a script state decision.

families.implemented_contract: singleChoice radio group, segmented single choice, multiChoice complete typed selected array, toggle and checkbox
families.remaining_gap: No tri-state checkbox or multi-select segmented row.

families.implemented_contract: rangeSlider with two ordered bounded numbers and optional step, Apply event
families.remaining_gap: No tick-label formatter, drag stream, or distinct drag-finished event.

families.implemented_contract: card, section, listItem, semantic containers, theme-scoped bounded shapes
families.remaining_gap: No generated Surface, arbitrary elevation, border, or slot functions.

families.family: Dialogs, bottom sheets, popups, and tooltips
families.implemented_contract: Script-controlled dialog/bottomSheet with visibleBind, unique dismiss action, validated child controls
families.remaining_gap: No arbitrary popup, tooltip, modal stack, or persistent sheet offset.

families.implemented_contract: Native appBar/bottomBar, typed navigationBar/navigationRail; host retains scaffold and authority
families.remaining_gap: No navigation drawer, generated route stack, collapsible app-bar scroll behavior, or independent system bars.

families.implemented_contract: Typed native menu/select popup, tabs, segmented choices
families.remaining_gap: No menu groups, separators, item icons, or script-controlled popup position.

families.implemented_contract: Determinate/indeterminate linear/ring progress, spinner, badge, snackbar, banner, skeleton
families.remaining_gap: No SnackbarHost queue/duration, anchored badge layout, or shimmer policy.

families.implemented_contract: Native date/time dialogs; Material date-range dialog emits ordered ISO pair, years 0001..9999
families.remaining_gap: No selectable-date predicate, picker style selector, time-zone field, or Material time-picker option.

families.implemented_contract: Bounded search input and Search/IME event; pager supplies bounded swipe pages
families.remaining_gap: No suggestions contract, expanded SearchBar, carousel, or pull-refresh event.

families.implemented_contract: Bounded line count/height, overflow, wrap, selectable text, scalar formats
families.remaining_gap: No generated locale formatter or downloadable font policy.

families.implemented_contract: Static ordered rich spans, SelectionContainer, validated link actions through existing capability broker
families.remaining_gap: No inline composable content, editable rich text, or generated clipboard service.

families.implemented_contract: input/search keyboard/IME choices, maxLines, password masking, explicit Apply/Search; numeric fields
families.remaining_gap: No read-only flag, transformation callbacks, selection/composition API, or custom validation message contract. Password masking does not encrypt state.

families.implemented_contract: Preset and system/light/dark mode; bounded opaque color pairs with contrast validation
families.remaining_gap: No dynamic-color opt-in, arbitrary color role, or user contrast-preference API.

families.implemented_contract: Bounded theme typeScale/cornerRadius; host font scaling retained
families.remaining_gap: No generated font files, arbitrary TextStyle, or per-component custom shape.

families.implemented_contract: Node click/longClick/doubleClick; collection horizontal swipe; pager swipe; labeled accessibility alternatives
families.remaining_gap: No node drag stream, zoom, drag/drop payload, arbitrary pointerInput, or generated nested-scroll policy.

families.implemented_contract: Focus-state boolean event, finite key shortcuts, native focusability, input keyboard/IME choice
families.remaining_gap: No focus request/order API, keyboard show/hide command, or draft selection restoration.

families.implemented_contract: Platform editing and text selection retain native host behavior
families.remaining_gap: No generated clipboard read/write, autofill hints, or credential service.

families.implemented_contract: Label, heading, stateDescription, polite/assertive liveRegion; long/double custom accessibility actions; native choice/range semantics
families.remaining_gap: No explicit traversal order/group, custom role enumeration, or collection metadata API. TalkBack workflow remains unrun.

families.implemented_contract: Existing validated native drawing-surface command contract and scoped input
families.remaining_gap: No arbitrary DrawScope, shader source, composable Canvas callbacks, or host drawing code.

families.implemented_contract: Owner-scoped opaque resource handles, bounded image decode, lifecycle/revocation checks, bounded glyph set
families.remaining_gap: No URL image fetch, generated vector paths, animated image, custom painter, or Material icon pack.

families.implemented_contract: Bounded transform pose, opacity, size and shared stage perspective
families.remaining_gap: No generated blur, RenderEffect, blend mode, runtime shader, or arbitrary graphicsLayer.

families.implemented_contract: transition boolean visibility with fade/fadeSlide/expand, bounded duration, reduced-motion zero duration, immediate hidden-action rejection
families.remaining_gap: No keyed content replacement or generic crossfade/shared-content identity contract.

families.implemented_contract: Existing finite decorative motion presets and eight-value transform interpolation
families.remaining_gap: No arbitrary easing, spring, keyframe, or infinite transition. Physical frame rate and touch latency remain unmeasured.

families.implemented_contract: No generated shared-element transition contract
families.remaining_gap: A future bounded shared-element identity and lifecycle design needs separate planning.

families.implemented_contract: Declared validated durable artifact state; host controls Compose snapshot state
families.remaining_gap: No generated snapshot/remember/derivedStateOf API or durable JavaScript globals.

families.implemented_contract: Existing broker, subscriptions and validated effects; host controls Compose effects
families.remaining_gap: Composition, focus, gestures, and control presence grant no native privilege or automatic capability authorization.

families.implemented_contract: Durable artifact state; native lazy and pager state; declarative selected/page/scroll targets
families.remaining_gap: No general focus/draft/offset restoration guarantee. Known controller cancellation defect remains outside this package.

families.implemented_contract: Route stack Back and native modal dismissal
families.remaining_gap: No generated predictive-back progress/cancel contract.

families.implemented_contract: Existing capability-specific result adapters retain host ownership
families.remaining_gap: Missing native services require explicit capability, authority and result contracts.

families.implemented_contract: Host lifecycle controls images, sandbox subscriptions and native composition
families.remaining_gap: Process-death, background subscriptions, and revocation require device workflow acceptance.

families.implemented_contract: AndroidView remains a native host implementation facility
families.remaining_gap: No generated AndroidView, WebView, view-binding, arbitrary Android API, or host code.

families.family: Compiler, inspection, preview, and UI tests
families.implemented_contract: Existing Android instrumentation compiles with the application
families.remaining_gap: No resolved Compose tooling/test-rule modules or Material2 contract. Instrumentation compilation does not prove rendered execution.
